name: CUSTODIA DE TEMPLETE, 1829
note: Sunburst processional monstrance (custodia de templete) from Seville, dated c. 1829 by the caption printed under the photo. The Pange Lingua catalogue cites a Palomino entry for a custodia procesional de templete.
credit: Photo: V. Herrera, per the caption printed under the image ("14. Custodia, Sevilla, Francisco de Paula Palomino, hacia 1829 (foto V. Herrera)").
